highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback.
highlights_body: Graphite is additive to Ganesh. Its explicit submission model and callback-scoped readback require different integration; an iOS simulator Metal gradient limitation remains.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to milestone 152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, retaining the Vulkan allocator fallback.

Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and an image cache. Graphite uses record, snap, insert, and submit; existing Ganesh behavior is unchanged. WebAssembly integrates browser WebGPU through Dawn.

SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Raster callbacks run synchronously; Ganesh work must be submitted and drained with GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. Graphite uses asynchronous rather than synchronous readback.

Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with typed backend-context and extension helpers, and makes GRVkExtensions directly constructible. The SharpVk package remains available; Silk.NET package production is included.

Region iterators retain their source region; derived pixmaps retain their pixel owner. Failed raster-image creation frees its pixel buffer, uniform Reset disposes the old data, and HarfBuzz blob cleanup disposes consumed non-memory-backed streams.
Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owning object, preventing an unlock through freed storage.

bullets.lead: Less copying on data and text paths
bullets.detail: SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets; .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 keep buffered writes. Text encoding, uniform lookup, object wrapping, feature-array shaping, and tag formatting reduce avoidable work.
Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes and includes further upstream font-rendering and Ganesh stability corrections.

The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so fonts loaded from files, streams, or data can render. It still has no system-font manager: applications must load fonts explicitly. Normal Windows DirectWrite builds are unchanged.
Produces Apple dSYM symbol packages separately from customer runtime packages and records deterministic Android build IDs for matching split-debug files.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled FreeType-backed font loading on Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Reduced Windows native build overhead by initializing the compiler environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend and its Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn integration.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Introduced Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and explicit font loading on Nano Server. Fixed region, pixmap, and raster-image source lifetimes and reduced data-path overhead.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Reduced feature-array and tag-formatting allocations, fixed uniform-buffer and HarfBuzz blob-stream cleanup, and restored Silk.NET package production. Added Apple symbol packages and deterministic Android symbol identity.

harfbuzz_summary: Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids boxing its four characters. Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android build IDs improve native debugging without upgrading the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 introduced Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, Nano Server font loading, and source-lifetime fixes.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: The release candidate reduced shaping allocations, fixed uniform-buffer and blob-stream cleanup, restored Silk.NET package production, and added native debugging assets.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 finalizes the release with a cached-data lifetime correction.
v4.152.0.body: The native mutex guard is released before its owning cached-data object is deleted.
